title: Unload, recover and reload fleet cargo
description: Four independent commanders enter through actual authenticated controls. Formation establishes a fleet; unload and load reserve infantry and move it once at leased settlement. Owner and other-player views show private orders and outcomes. Fixed catalogue/domain clocks are explicit harness controls. Development transport capacity and tick rules remain under review; this does not certify travel, managed encryption or hosted scheduling.
